summary: Frontend-only regression + design correction verification. Homepage cinematic hero, numbered kicker removal, ecosystem/hardware/connectivity/intelligence/value/solutions/proof/insights sections, nav resizing, mobile responsiveness (390/320), contact form flow (demo-success), hardware pills, and cross-page nav regression (/product, /products/compare, /resources/blog, /about, /careers) all pass. One design-spec deviation found: an H2 outside the allowed list contains green words.

issues: H2 'Build the Connected Experience You Want.' has 'Experience You Want.' rendered in green. Spec says green should only appear on hero 'Platform.' and intelligence 'Into Action.'. Recommendation: remove the green highlight span from this heading in HomeSections.jsx (kicker 'Connected Experience').

action_items: Remove green highlight from the contact chapter H2 ('Experience You Want.') so only hero 'Platform.' and intelligence 'Into Action.' remain green, per this round's design spec.
critical_code_review_comments: BrandPreview.jsx still contains numeric kicker prefixes ('01 / SELECT YOUR MODEL', '02 / ADD YOUR BRAND', '03 / DEVICE FINISH'). This lives on /product Look & Feel — not the homepage, so it does not violate the homepage spec — but if the 'no numeric kickers' rule is site-wide, these should be removed for consistency.
Three.js warning 'THREE.Clock deprecated, use THREE.Timer' emitted multiple times per WebGL scene. Non-blocking but should be addressed by updating drei/three usages.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified on preview https://network-journey-3.preview.emergentagent.com with cache-busting ?v=. Hero testids (hero-section, hero-headline, hero-visual, hero-node-0/1/2, hero-cta-primary/secondary) present. Primary CTA scrolls (0 -> 4080px, #platform top ~0). Secondary CTA → /product. TELEMETRY marker present (5x). Nav pill: 70px at rest, 62px scrolled (spec 64–72 at rest OK). Kickers: 10 present (integrated-flow, hardware, connectivity, software, the-tonaer-flow, intelligence, business-value, connected-experience, proof, insights) — NO numeric prefixes anywhere on homepage. All eco-node-0..5 & intel-stage-0..4 present. connectivity-bridge, hardware-showcase, signature-flow, platform-dashboard, business-value, solutions, whitelabel-band, testimonials, insights-teaser, chapter-contact, site-footer all mount. Contact form submit shows demo-success. Mobile 390 & 320 no horizontal overflow; nav-cta-demo visible on mobile. Regression pages /product, /products/compare, /resources/blog, /about, /careers load with nav at 70px. Only spec violation: green words on H2 'Build the Connected Experience You Want.' in the contact chapter.
rca of the issue: In /app/frontend/src/components/HomeSections.jsx the 'Connected Experience' chapter title still wraps 'Experience You Want.' in the green <span>. Design spec for this iteration restricts green-word H2s to hero 'Platform.' and intelligence 'Into Action.' only. Fix: unwrap the green span for that heading.
